label: Quest
description: This quest marks the culmination of the investigation into the Venture Company machinery in the northern Barrens. Having dismantled the system's defenses…
intro: This quest marks the culmination of the investigation into the Venture Company machinery in the northern Barrens. Having dismantled the system's defenses and shut down the control console, you extract the elusive samophlange itself and bring it back to Ratchet for evaluation. It proves to be far more finicky and fragile than anyone could have predicted.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Oh, you're back, friend! Do you have the samophlange?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is... Er... Interesting... Yes. I'll have it sent along to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine. I'm sure after some careful dissection and research, they'll be able to make some sense of it.
But, perhaps I'll have a little look myself first...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
